title: slightly odd, but easy to clean and the right size for my countertop oven
text:
slightly odd, but easy to clean and the right size for my countertop oven. howdy y'all,

these pans are a tad odd. [*grin*]

all the items have an easy to clean surface. all three pans have nicely rolled edges.

- cookie pan
it's a PAN, not a sheet. that raised rim all the way around reduces the usable size rather a lot. however, the roasting rack fits perfectly and is usable IF the item being roasted doesn't generate much splatter.

- roasting rack
it fits both the cookie pan and the roasting/baking pan. a tad annoying to clean, but that is normal for a rack. [*grin*]

- muffin pan
very easy to clean. no need for any liner. made cornbread muffins several times now and they came out of the pan easily.

- baking/roasting pan
this one is slightly annoying. not _quite_ enuf to remove a star, but almost.
== it's made by folding the metal instead of pressing or forging. that means the corners are all creases that are sometimes difficult to clean.
== there is no gripping area. my other pans of this general size have an area for picking up the pan at each end. not so here.

*****
all of these items seem well built and feel substantial. i expect them to last for a while - at least until the non-stick coating begins to fail.

rated a THREE since it doesn't _quite_ deserve a two.

take care,
lee
